commit.message:
scd:piv: Support the administration key of the Nitrokey 3

* scd/app-piv.c (auth_adm_key): Use the current algorithm identifier
for 3DES and fall back to the legacy one. Retry without the empty
response tag if the card rejects it. Report a 6A80 of that retry as
bad authentication.

--

scdaemon could not authenticate with the administration key of a
Nitrokey 3 and thus could neither generate nor import keys on it.
The PIV application of the Nitrokey 3 differs in two ways:
- For 3DES it only accepts the identifier 0x03 and rejects the
  legacy identifier 0x00, which scdaemon used, with 6A86.
- It rejects the empty response tag (82 00) in the second GENERAL
  AUTHENTICATE command with 6A80. SP 800-73-5 Part 2 includes this
  tag in its example in Table 23.

Request the witness for 3DES with 0x03 first, which is also what
Yubico's yubikit and set_adm_key use, and fall back to 0x00. Keep
sending the empty response tag, and only if the card rejects the
command retry without it, which is how yubikit sends the command;
this requires a new witness. The Nitrokey 3 also answers a wrong key
with 6A80, so report that as bad authentication.

Tested with the default administration keys:

  Card                    Key      Result
  ----------------------  -------  ------------------------------------
  Nitrokey 3              3DES     works with the retry without 82 00
  YubiKey 4 (4.3.7)       3DES     0x03 and 82 00 work at first attempt
  YubiKey 5 NFC (5.1.2)   3DES     0x03 and 82 00 work at first attempt
  YubiKey 5C NFC (5.7.1)  AES-192  commands unchanged
  TOKEN2 PIN+ R3.3        AES-192  commands unchanged

On the Nitrokey 3 a P-256 key can now be generated in slot 95. On all
five cards a wrong key is reported as "Bad authentication" (6A80 on
the Nitrokey 3, 6982 on the others).

Signed-off-by: David Seifert <soap@gentoo.org>

commit.message:
gpg: Fix TOFU trust models to actually check UTK signatures.

* g10/tofu.c (signed_by_utk): Add arg ctrl.  Use macros fro the
  sigclass.  Check the signature before returning true.
--

This bug sits here since the introduction of the TOFU models.  It is
just another nail into the coffin of _this_ TOFU implementation.
What we do in gpg is way to complicated and maybe even more complicate
than the WoT it tried to simplify.  One major problem with our
implementation with all its heuristics, is that one may only check a
file once to not mess up the statistics.  This is highly impractical in
real life.  Tofu checking belongs to the caller, for example the
address book of the mail client.

GnuPG-bug-id: 8404
Reported-by: arthur.chan@adalogics.com
Fixes-commit: 8df8aa13c795e400324a782fbaea578c8f2a1398
